description: Categorical-fill component tag contract. The component selects one semantic case from a reusable presentation-level classification scheme; trusted RGB styling is resolved by the renderer and is never generated by AI.

efficio_component_type.description: Identifies this shape or native PowerPoint group as a categorical-fill component.

efficio_classification_scheme_id.description: References one scheme_id from the presentation-level efficio_classification_schemes registry.

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Classify the German market using German evidence only.
